name: Riverglades
summary: In Riverglades, human loyalists and Horde outposts still contest a valley east of the Badlands and Burning Steppes. Stormwind once claimed the region, but the Old Horde overran it in the First War. The Redridge Mountains lie southwest, the Swamp of Sorrows south, and Tanaris across the sea.

sections.title: A Forgotten Borderland
sections.body: Before the First War, Riverglades belonged to the Kingdom of Stormwind. Then the Old Horde swept through. Orcs sacked Sunnyglade but spared its mage tower to study human sorcery. They enslaved the townsfolk who survived. Stormwind soldiers tried to free the captives and rebuild, but the kingdom judged the valley lost and sent its strength to defend the core homelands. For years, the crown gave Riverglades little formal support.

sections.title: The Struggle for Farholde
sections.body: Stormwind's leaders left Riverglades behind, yet its human defenders never fully surrendered their homeland. Knight Commander Demar Brant leads the remaining loyalists of the legendary brotherhood of the horse. They hold farholde keep against the wilderness and hostile invaders. Nearby, the modern Horde keeps a strong presence at outposts such as rog'mar and bolder'ok. The old struggle over the glades continues.

sections.title: Geography and Travel
sections.body: Riverglades follows the coast of the Forbidding Sea, among mountains and winding waterways. You can cross west through Blackrock Pass to the Burning Steppes, or travel southwest through Redridge Pass to the Redridge Mountains. South lies the Swamp of Sorrows. To the northwest, trails pass Twilight's Shroud into the Badlands. At powderfuse port, you can take a boat across the sea to steamwheedle port in Tanaris.

faq.answer: Riverglades lies east of the Badlands and Burning Steppes, along the Forbidding Sea. Stormwind once claimed the region. Now the Alliance holds Farholde Keep while the Horde keeps Rog'mar.

The Old Horde raided and destroyed Sunnyglade during the First War. Orcs enslaved the surviving villagers but kept a local mage tower intact to study human magic. Stormwind soldiers tried to free the captives and rebuild, but the kingdom finally abandoned the area to defend its western borders.

Alliance loyalists hold Farholde Keep under Knight Commander Demar Brant of the Brotherhood of the Horse. His forces have spent years fighting to reclaim Riverglades after Stormwind gave the territory up as lost.

faq.q: How do you reach Tanaris from the Riverglades?
faq.answer: From Powderfuse Port on Riverglades' eastern shore, a coastal boat runs regularly to Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris, crossing directly over the sea.

faq.q: What passes lead into other zones?
faq.answer: You can travel southwest through Redridge Pass to reach the Redridge Mountains, or head south toward the Swamp of Sorrows. Westward, Blackrock Pass leads past the Bristle Hills to the Burning Steppes. Trails north of Twilight's Shroud run directly into the Badlands.
Krol'dok Stronghold is a fortified dungeon complex in Riverglades and a major seat of hostile power in the contested territory.

angles.text: As an Alliance soldier, you find old wounds laid bare in Riverglades. Remnants of the Brotherhood of the Horse continue their quiet crusade to retake land Stormwind abandoned during the First War.
For the Horde, outposts such as Rog'mar secure a coastal foothold and keep pressure on the old human strongholds east of Redridge.
As a human, you can see a tragic chapter of your heritage in Sunnyglade. It recalls the heavy toll the First War took on your kingdom's eastern frontier.
